a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (wait for 8 in reserve) means we'll very likely both be caught short. Reaching 8 takes at least 2 rounds of joint operation. I want to keep our agreement, but I'd like to hear your view first. What are you planning for round 1? I won't hide my action. I'll tell you plainly whatever I do.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating with you, keeping our agreement. Once the reserve reaches 8 we take 4 each, no more.
